<h3>模型边界</h3><p><strong>这是一套概念可视化课件，不是经过:
Model limits

A conceptual teaching model, not a calibrated geophysical simulation. Terrain, time, flows and particle sizes are illustrative. Parameters are dimensionless relative values, not measured pressure, temperature, wind speed or hazard levels.

Terrain comes from mathematical functions and procedural geometry, not surveyed elevation or satellite data. The overview combines environments that need not coexist. Rivers and glaciers follow preset evolution paths rather than complete fluid or ice dynamics. Shape interpolation illustrates relationships. Crust thickness is exaggerated and the continents are not an accurate map.

The chapters cover selected landforms and Earth systems, not an entire geography curriculum. They do not provide hazard forecasts.

山海之间，看见塑造地球的力量。: Between mountains and oceans, see the forces shaping Earth.
不是静止的风景，而是一颗持续变化的星球。选择一个地貌，走进它的形成过程。: A changing planet, not a still landscape. Choose a landform to explore how it develops.
内力作用与外力作用同时影响地表，并非彼此割裂。: Internal and external processes act on the surface together.
这里把不同环境组合成地貌索引，不代表一个真实地区。: This index combines different environments; it is not a real region.
点击三维标签，可以进入独立的地貌实验。: Select a 3D label to enter a landform experiment.
山峰升高与河谷加深，可以同时发生吗？: Can mountains rise while river valleys deepen?
可以。构造抬升与流水侵蚀可以同时进行，它们的相对速率会影响地表起伏。: Yes. Uplift and river erosion can occur together. Their relative rates influence relief.
打开地球的一道窗口，观察岩浆如何抵达地表。: Open a window into the Earth and follow magma to the surface.
气体膨胀、岩浆流动、火山灰升腾。一次完整的喷发过程，可以在这里暂停和重放。: Gas expansion, magma flow and rising ash. Pause and replay a complete eruption.
岩浆位于地下；到达地表后称为熔岩。: Molten rock underground is magma; at the surface it is lava.
气体含量、温度、成分和黏度等因素共同影响喷发行为。: Gas content, temperature, composition and viscosity all influence eruptions.
高黏度不等于必然爆炸性喷发；参数仅演示部分关系。: High viscosity does not guarantee an explosive eruption. These controls illustrate only part of the relationship.
火山灰是“烧完以后留下的灰”吗？: Is volcanic ash the residue of something burning?
不是。火山灰主要是细小的岩石、矿物及火山玻璃碎屑。模型中的灰柱也不是普通烟囱的烟: No. It consists mainly of small rock, mineral and volcanic-glass fragments. The plume is not ordinary smoke.
碰撞、张裂与错动，写在岩层里的运动。: Collision, spreading and sliding, recorded in rock layers.
将漫长的构造过程压缩为可观察的形变。三种边界分别展示，避免概念混淆。: Geological time is compressed into visible deformation. Three boundary types are shown separately.
岩石圈板块相互运动，边界可表现为聚合、离散或转换。: Lithospheric plates move relative to each other at convergent, divergent or transform boundaries.
褶皱是岩层弯曲；断层是岩体沿破裂面发生相对位移。: Folding bends layers; faulting displaces rock along a fracture.
地表的山谷与背斜、向斜不能只按“高低”一一对应。: Hills and valleys do not map directly to anticlines and synclines.
所有板块边界都会生成新的地壳吗？: Does every plate boundary create new crust?
不会。在理想转换边界，板块主要水平错动；离散边界的海底扩张中心才常伴随新洋壳形成: No. Ideal transform boundaries mainly accommodate horizontal motion. New oceanic crust commonly forms at divergent spreading centers.
从山谷到海洋，水带走什么，又留下什么？: From mountains to sea, what does water carry away and leave behind?
让地表逐渐切开，看见 V 形谷、曲流与沉积三角洲。: Watch valleys deepen, meanders migrate and deltas accumulate.
侵蚀、搬运与沉积可在一条河流的不同位置同时发生。: Erosion, transport and deposition can occur simultaneously at different places along one river.
曲流通常凹岸侵蚀、凸岸堆积，河道会迁移。: Meanders commonly erode their outer banks and deposit on inner banks, causing migration.
三角洲能否形成，还取决于波浪、潮汐、海平面与沉积空间等。: Delta formation also depends on waves, tides, sea level and space for sediment accumulation.
“上游只有侵蚀，下游只有堆积”对吗？: Is erosion limited to upstream and deposition to downstream?
不对。这是过度简化。同一河段不同位置可以发生不同作用，洪水过程也会改变侵蚀与沉积: No. Different processes occur within a single reach, and floods change erosion and deposition patterns.
看似静止的冰川，正在拓宽整条山谷。: A glacier that looks still is widening a valley.
比较河谷与冰蚀谷，观察冰体下滑、侧碛和冰川末端退缩。: Compare river and glacial valleys; observe ice flow, lateral moraines and a retreating terminus.
冰川在重力作用下缓慢流动，不是完全静止的冰块。: Glaciers flow slowly under gravity; they are not stationary blocks of ice.
磨蚀与拔蚀共同影响冰川地貌。: Abrasion and plucking both shape glacial landscapes.
末端退缩不意味着冰体向山上倒流。: A retreating terminus does not mean ice flows uphill.
冰川正在退缩时，冰还可能向下运动吗？: Can ice still move downhill while a glacier retreats?
可能。末端位置取决于冰的补给与消融等因素；即使冰体持续向下流动，末端仍可能因消融: Yes. Terminus position depends on accumulation and loss. Ice can keep flowing downhill while melting causes the front to retreat.
地表的峰林之下，还有另一条隐秘的水路。: Beneath limestone towers lies a hidden water route.
剥开石灰岩，认识溶蚀、地下河、石钟乳与石笋。: Open the limestone and explore dissolution, underground rivers, stalactites and stalagmites.
碳酸盐岩的溶蚀与水、二氧化碳及岩石结构有关。: Carbonate dissolution depends on water, carbon dioxide and rock structure.
喀斯特不仅包括峰林，还包括溶洞、落水洞、地下河等。: Karst includes caves, sinkholes and underground rivers as well as limestone towers.
石钟乳、石笋常来自碳酸钙沉积，不是岩石溶蚀后直接剩下的柱子。: Stalactites and stalagmites commonly form by calcium-carbonate deposition, not simply as leftover pillars after erosion.
溶洞变大和石笋长高，是同一种作用吗？: Do cave enlargement and stalagmite growth result from the same process?
不是。前者主要涉及溶蚀，后者主要涉及矿物沉积。两种过程可以出现在同一套喀斯特系统: No. Enlargement mainly involves dissolution; stalagmite growth mainly involves mineral deposition. Both can occur in one karst system.
从洞顶向下发育的通常称为？: What typically grows down from a cave ceiling?
一粒沙的跃动，最终改变一整片沙丘。: The motion of individual grains reshapes a dune.
观察沙粒的搬运、背风坡堆积和沙脊迁移；再比较风蚀雅丹。: Observe transport, lee-side deposition and ridge migration; compare erosional yardangs.
沙丘是风积地貌；雅丹属于侵蚀地貌。: Dunes are depositional; yardangs are erosional.
沙粒可以蠕移、跃移或悬移，取决于粒径和风力等。: Grains creep, saltate or remain suspended depending on size, wind and other conditions.
改变风向会先改变沙粒运动，已有沙丘不会瞬间转身。: A wind shift changes grain movement first; existing dunes do not instantly turn around.
沙丘迁移，是整座沙丘在地面滑动吗？: Does a migrating dune slide across the ground as one block?
不是。沙粒不断从迎风侧搬运，并在背风侧沉积，使沙丘形态和位置逐步改变。: No. Grains move up the windward side and accumulate downwind, gradually changing the dune's shape and position.
下面哪一个主要属于风积地貌？: Which is mainly a wind-deposited landform?
一道拱门、一根岩柱，记录着海浪长久的来访。: An arch and a pillar record repeated visits by waves.
持续运动的波浪，与远慢于它的海岸演化，在同一模型中对照。: Compare moving waves with the much slower evolution of a coast.
海蚀洞可在薄弱部位发育，贯通岬角后可形成海蚀拱。: Caves can develop in weak rock and form arches when they cut through a headland.
拱顶坍塌后可能留下海蚀柱，岩柱仍会继续被侵蚀。: Arch collapse may leave a sea stack, which continues to erode.
海岸演变也受到岩性、构造、潮汐与海平面变化等影响。: Rock type, structures, tides and sea-level change also influence coasts.
海蚀柱是不是海岸侵蚀的最终状态？: Is a sea stack the final stage of coastal erosion?
不是。海蚀柱仍会继续风化、侵蚀和坍塌，可能成为较低的残留礁石或被进一步移除。: No. Weathering, erosion and collapse continue. A stack may become a low stump or disappear.
蒸发、凝结、降水、径流，把山海连在一起。: Evaporation, condensation, precipitation and runoff connect land and sea.
用可见的粒子，追踪原本不可见的水汽。观察不同环节的联系。: Visible particles trace invisible vapor and connect parts of the cycle.
水循环由太阳能、重力等共同驱动。: Solar energy and gravity help drive the water cycle.
蒸发、降水与径流常同时发生，不是全地球排队进行的五个步骤。: Evaporation, precipitation and runoff often occur at once; they are not five globally synchronized steps.
模型突出海陆间循环的一条路线，未穷尽蒸腾、下渗等所有路径。: The model highlights one ocean–land route, not every path such as transpiration and infiltration.
云中的水是看不见的水蒸气吗？: Are clouds made of invisible water vapor?
云主要由悬浮的小水滴、冰晶或两者组成。水蒸气本身不可见，图中的黄色粒子是帮助理解: Clouds mainly contain suspended droplets, ice crystals or both. Vapor is invisible; yellow particles are a visual aid.
水从海洋进入大气，通常首先涉及？: What usually first moves ocean water into the atmosphere?
从薄薄的地壳，到炽热而高压的核心。: From a thin crust to a hot, highly pressurized core.
逐层认识地壳、地幔、外核与内核，建立对地球内部的空间理解。: Explore the crust, mantle, outer core and inner core in three dimensions.
地壳与上部地幔的刚性部分构成岩石圈。: The crust and rigid uppermost mantle together form the lithosphere.
地幔绝大部分为固态岩石，不能画成全球性的岩浆海。: Most of the mantle is solid rock, not a global magma ocean.
外核主要为液态，内核主要为固态；状态同时受温度与压力影响。: The outer core is mainly liquid and the inner core solid; both temperature and pressure affect state.
“地下温度高，所以越往下越是液态”对吗？: Does increasing temperature underground mean everything deeper is liquid?
不对。物质状态取决于温度、压力和成分等。内核虽温度很高，在巨大压力下仍主要为固态: No. State depends on temperature, pressure and composition. Enormous pressure keeps the hot inner core mainly solid.
未能创建 WebGL 2。请开启浏览器硬件加速，并在新版浏览器中打开。: WebGL 2 could not start. Enable graphics acceleration and use a current browser.
此设备不支持当前渲染缓冲格式。: This device does not support the required render-buffer format.
火山口与地下通道相连；不规则的边缘记录着喷发与塌陷。: The crater connects to conduits below. Its irregular rim reflects eruption and collapse.
地表熔岩沿坡流动，边缘逐渐冷却，形成较暗的壳与堤。这里夸大了可见流动。: Lava flows downhill and cools into dark crusts and levees. Visible movement is exaggerated.
火山灰是细小的岩石、矿物与火山玻璃碎屑；不是燃烧后的烟灰。: Volcanic ash consists of tiny rock, mineral and glass fragments, not soot from burning.
储集区、主通道与侧向裂隙均为结构示意；真实岩浆系统可能含有大量晶体。: Storage, conduits and side fractures are schematic. Real magma systems may contain abundant crystals.
触发喷发，观察灰柱、抛射物、分支熔岩与逐步冷却。打开剖面可看到内部通道。: Trigger an eruption and observe ash, ejecta, branching lava and cooling. Open the section to see conduits.
进入冰川章节，比较流水与冰川塑造的谷地。: Compare valleys shaped by rivers and glaciers.
进入火山实验，改变气体驱动与黏度，触发一次喷发。: Change gas drive and viscosity, then trigger an eruption.
进入风成地貌，观察沙脊迁移与沙粒的跃动。: Watch ridge migration and hopping sand grains.
进入海岸章节，观察海蚀拱的坍塌与海蚀柱。: Observe arch collapse and the remaining stack.
独立的火山、河流、冰川、喀斯特、沙丘与海岸实验。点击地貌标记进入。: Select labels to enter volcano, river, glacier, karst, dune and coastal experiments.
曲流外侧常易受侵蚀；弯道不断迁移，而不是只沿固定沟槽流水。: Outer bends commonly erode. The bend migrates instead of remaining a fixed channel.
内侧水流搬运能力变化，可形成泥沙边滩。浅色边滩突出侵蚀与沉积的对照。: Changing transport capacity on the inner bend can produce point bars. Light sediment contrasts with eroding banks.
旧河道与主河道分离后可形成牛轭湖。模型并置结果以便课堂比较。: An abandoned bend can become an oxbow lake. Stages are placed together here for comparison.
流水下切、坡面过程和构造条件共同影响谷地形态。: River incision, slope processes and tectonic conditions all affect valley shape.
随着演化，河床降低，谷坡在两侧逐渐显现。: As the bed lowers, valley sides gradually emerge.
同一条河流的不同位置可以同时发生侵蚀、搬运和沉积。: One river can erode, transport and deposit material at different locations simultaneously.
表面、河道、树木和边滩随同一地形演化，避免河流悬浮。切换子场景比较侵蚀与沉积。: Terrain, channel, trees and bars evolve together. Switch sub-scenes to compare erosion and deposition.
河流进入海洋，泥沙输送、波浪与潮汐共同决定沉积能否保存。: Sediment supply, waves and tides influence whether deposits persist at the coast.
多条河道把水和泥沙输送到三角洲前缘。: Distributaries carry water and sediment to the delta front.
拖动时间轴，看沉积体逐渐露出水面。不是所有河口都会形成三角洲。: Scrub the timeline to see deposits emerge. Not every river mouth forms a delta.
细颗粒显示泥沙路径，浅水颜色标识沉积前缘。几何演化为概念模型，非沉积通量计算。: Particles show sediment paths and shallow-water colors mark the depositional front. Geometry is conceptual, not a sediment-flux calculation.
积雪经压实和变质形成冰川冰；重力使冰体向下运动。: Snow compacts and transforms into glacier ice, which moves downhill under gravity.
拉伸可使冰体产生裂隙。谷地的拓宽加深则来自冰川侵蚀等过程。: Stretching opens crevasses; glacial erosion helps widen and deepen the valley.
末端后退不等于冰体向山上倒流。观察冰面颗粒的运动方向。: Retreat does not mean uphill ice flow. Follow particles on the surface.
两侧的碎石带用三维颗粒表现，不是贴在冰面上的线。: Debris along the margins is shown as three-dimensional grains.
冰裂隙有实际的表面凹陷；末端连续退缩，冰体仍沿谷地向下流。空间与时间均经夸张。: Crevasses indent the surface. The front retreats while ice flows downhill. Space and time are exaggerated.
峰体的侧壁、节理与坡顶有不同的细节。峰林由岩体被溶蚀分割而成，不是从平地长出。: Dissolution separates rock masses into towers; they do not simply grow out of flat ground.
含二氧化碳的水沿裂隙溶蚀碳酸盐岩，可逐渐扩大地下通道。: Water containing carbon dioxide dissolves carbonate rock along fractures, enlarging passages.
从洞顶向下的石钟乳、从洞底向上的石笋，主要由矿物沉积形成。: Ceiling stalactites and floor stalagmites mainly grow through mineral deposition.
地表水与地下水可通过裂隙、落水洞和泉相互联系。: Fractures, sinkholes and springs connect surface water and groundwater.
打开剖面，观察凹入的洞壁、钟乳石、石笋、滴水和地下河。不同过程的时间尺度经过夸张: Open the section to inspect cave walls, mineral formations, drips and an underground river. Timescales are exaggerated.
风蚀与其他侵蚀作用形成垄岗和沟槽；雅丹并不是沙丘。: Wind and other erosional processes carve ridges and grooves. Yardangs are not dunes.
垄岗沿主导风向延伸，具体形态也受岩性、水流等影响。: Ridges often align with prevailing winds; rock and water also affect their form.
颗粒在迎风侧向上搬运；细小波纹与沙丘主脊分属不同空间尺度。: Grains move uphill on the windward side. Ripples and dune crests occur at different scales.
越过沙脊的沙粒在背风侧堆积、滑落，形成常较陡的坡面。: Grains cross the crest, accumulate and slip down the often steeper lee side.
迁移来自沙粒反复搬运和堆积；不是整个沙丘沿地面滑动。: Repeated transport and deposition move the dune; the whole dune does not slide as a block.
宽阔、缓起的迎风坡与陡落的背风坡；微小沙纹和跃移颗粒一起表现风的尺度。: A broad windward slope meets a steep lee face. Ripples and hopping grains show smaller scales of wind action.
海浪与风化等共同侵蚀岸坡，使海岸线逐渐后退。: Waves and weathering erode cliffs and move the shoreline landward.
海蚀洞贯通岬角后可形成海蚀拱。拖动演化阶段观察拱顶坍塌，留下残留岩柱。: A cave may cut through a headland to form an arch. Scrub the timeline to collapse its roof and reveal a stack.
与陆地分离的残留岩柱仍会继续受到侵蚀，不是演化的终点。: The isolated pillar continues to erode; it is not the end of the process.
波浪向岸传播，近岸水深、浪高与岩岸形态共同影响破碎。白色泡沫用于提示过程。: Depth, wave height and shoreline form influence breaking. White foam marks the process.
观察岩岸断面、海蚀拱的空洞和逐渐下坠的拱顶。青绿浅水、近岸泡沫与深海颜色连续过渡: Inspect cliff sections, the arch opening and falling roof. Shallow turquoise water grades into the deeper sea.
受到挤压时，岩层可能发生弯曲。地表形态不一定与背斜、向斜简单对应。: Compression can bend layers. Surface highs and lows do not map directly to anticlines and synclines.
大陆碰撞可造成地壳缩短、增厚与山脉抬升。模型夸大了形变。: Continental collision can shorten and thicken crust and raise mountains. Deformation is exaggerated.
箭头表示相对运动方向，不代表真实移动速度。: Arrows indicate relative direction, not actual speed.
板块相互分离；在海底扩张中心，岩浆可上升并形成新的洋壳。: Plates separate. At spreading centers, magma may rise and form new oceanic crust.
张裂可产生断裂与地表凹陷。这里用简化的板块平移展示关系。: Extension can fault and lower the surface. Simplified plate motion illustrates the relationship.
板块沿边界水平错动。理想转换边界既不生成也不消耗岩石圈。: Plates slide horizontally. An ideal transform neither creates nor consumes lithosphere.
断层的滑动可释放积累的弹性应变能并产生地震。: Fault slip can release stored elastic strain energy as earthquakes.
三种边界各有独立模型。褶皱岩层连续形变；板块错动和张裂可由时间轴逐步观察。: Three boundaries have separate models. Scrub the timeline to inspect continuous folding, sliding and extension.
液态水转为水蒸气进入大气。黄色粒子只是用来显示不可见的水汽。: Liquid water evaporates into the atmosphere. Yellow particles make invisible vapor traceable.
空气中的水汽随大气运动输送；冷却达到适当条件时可凝结成云滴或冰晶。: Air motion transports vapor. Cooling under suitable conditions can form droplets or ice crystals.
云中水滴或冰晶增长后，可能以雨、雪等形式落向地表。: Growing droplets or crystals can fall as rain, snow or other precipitation.
水以地表和地下径流等方式运动。这里突出海陆间水循环的一条路径。: Water moves in surface and underground flows. One ocean–land route is emphasized here.
黄色水汽、细雨与贴合坡面的径流同时运动；调节蒸发与降水时，粒子速度平滑变化而不重: Vapor, rain and slope-following runoff move together. Parameters change particle speeds smoothly.
最外层固体岩石外壳，厚度相对地球半径很小。这里显著夸大了地壳厚度。: The outer solid-rock shell is thin relative to Earth's radius. Its thickness is greatly exaggerated here.
地幔绝大部分是固态岩石，但在地质时间尺度上可以发生缓慢的塑性流动。: Most mantle rock is solid, but it can deform and flow slowly over geological time.
外核主要为液态铁合金。不能把外核、地幔与火山岩浆储集区混为一谈。: The outer core is mainly liquid iron alloy, distinct from the mantle and magma storage regions.
内核主要为固态铁合金。高温不必然意味着液态，压力同样重要。: The inner core is mainly solid iron alloy. High temperature alone does not determine state; pressure matters.
高细分球面、程序化地表与缓慢流动的云层。地壳厚度夸大；大陆不是实际测绘地图。: Procedural land and slowly moving clouds. Crust thickness is exaggerated and continents are not an accurate map.
三维模型。拖动旋转，滚轮缩放，Shift 拖动平移。: Drag to rotate, wheel to zoom, Shift-drag to pan.
所有模型与动效，都在本地生成。: Geometry and motion are generated locally.
